info.title: WaiFai Engine API
info.description: WaiFai Engine API v1: payment-gated enrollment (4-minute session, max 3 failed attempts), company billing/renewal, optional installation/router orders, captive portal, hotspot operations, staff, and platform administration. Envelope: { status, code, message, data }. Platform ops require an active subscription (except /billing/*).

get.description: Named login fallback. Returns a JSON error instead of a web login page.

post.description: Available only after successful enrollment payment and account creation.
Always returns a generic success message to avoid account enumeration.
Superadmin only. Creates another superadmin or a normal platform admin. A temporary password is generated and emailed. No company is created.

get.description: Returns the current user, companies, current company, membership, and permissions. Token is omitted.

post.summary: Revoke all tokens for the user

403.description: Not a member or company inactive

200.description: Verification email sent, or already verified

get.description: Available even when subscription is expired so the tenant can renew. Does not require subscription.active middleware.

post.description: Creates a platform payment of type subscription_renewal for PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY. Amount is server-side; client amount is optional and must match if sent. When payment is marked paid, subscription period is extended by one month.

amount.description: Optional; must equal configured monthly fee

post.description: Creates a temporary enrollment (no user/company yet), initiates the monthly platform subscription payment, and triggers a USSD/STK push to payment_phone. Enrollment expires after PLATFORM_ENROLLMENT_TTL_MINUTES (default 4). Account creation happens only after trusted payment confirmation.

get.description: Public polling endpoint for the payment waiting screen. Does not expose password hashes or provider secrets. Returns 410 when the enrollment has expired.

post.description: Allowed while enrollment is not expired and fewer than 3 failed attempts have occurred. Optionally updates payment_phone. Does not create a new enrollment.

Authoritative payment confirmation. Requires X-Platform-Payment-Secret when PLATFORM_PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set. On paid enrollment payments, creates user + company + active subscription. Idempotent under replay.

get.summary: List installation requests for the current company
get.description: Requires active subscription and installation_requests.view permission.

post.description: Backend calculates unit_price and total_amount from config. Client must not send prices. Creates one item row per quantity. Payment and fulfillment start as pending/requested.

get.summary: Installation request details with progress tracker
get.description: Customer-visible updates only (internal notes omitted). Includes progress steps for UI tracker.

post.summary: Start payment for an installation request
post.description: Amount must match the request total_amount snapshot. Creates a platform payment of type installation.

amount.description: Optional; must match request total if sent

Platform admin: request details including internal updates

post.description: Router and package must belong to the current company and not be soft-deleted. Missing or deleted refs return 422 (not 404).

router_id.description: Active company router id. Soft-deleted routers are rejected.

package_id.description: Active company package id. Soft-deleted packages are rejected.

custom_code.description: Numbers only. Allowed only when quantity is 1. Leave empty to auto-generate.

max_uses.description: Max uses per code. Defaults to 1.

422.description: Validation error — including missing/deleted router_id or package_id, custom_code rules, or duplicate custom_code

Write a hotspot session after payment / captive portal success
post.description: Call this when the captive portal has authenticated the device. Pass payment_transaction_id (creates an access grant if needed) or an existing access_grant_id from voucher consume. Soft-deleted or foreign routers return 422.

payment_transaction_id.description: Paid payment that unlocks access. Required if access_grant_id is omitted.

access_grant_id.description: Existing grant (e.g. from voucher consume). Required if payment_transaction_id is omitted.

router_id.description: Active company router id. Soft-deleted routers are rejected with 422.

session_id.description: External hotspot session id from the gateway

404.description: Payment or access grant not found

422.description: Validation error — including missing payment/grant, unpaid payment, expired grant, invalid MAC, or missing/deleted router_id
